content: Avidya kshetram uttaresham prasupta tanu vichhinnodaranam. (Ignorance of our true nature is the breeding ground for all other afflictions).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Avidya kshetram uttaresham prasupta tanu vichhinnodaranam. (...) focuses directly on avidya and kshetram. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on avidya today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper avidya and kshetram in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
